full_judgment: 2. The relevant facts leading to the filing of the above revision are that the opposite party Nos.1-8 as plaintiffs instituted a suit being Title Suit No.131 of 1999 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Khulna for specific performance of contract and for confirmation of possession and in the alternative to adverse possession in respect of the suit land alleging, inter alia, that .12 acres of land of Plot No.1044 of C.S. Khatian No.1262 of Monza No.4, Tootpara within Police Station and District Khulna was belonged to Denatullah Sheikh; who entered into a contract for selling .12 acres of land of Plot No.1044 of C.S. Khatian No.I262 with Lutfor Rahman, the maternal grand-father of Iftekharuddin Ahmed and Nasimuddin Ahmed and executed a bainapatra in favour of him on 28.4.1972 and delivered possession thereof. As per said bainapatra Denatullah Sheikh executed and registered a kabala No.16882 in favour of the plaintiff side for only .07 acres of land on 21.10.74 because there was a suit pending before the then Munsif, 10 Court, Khulna concerning .05 acres of land out of the impugned .12 acres. It has mentioned in the contract that after the disposal of the suit a separate kabala for .05 acres of land would be executed and registered but the said kabala could not be executed due to the sickness of Denatullah Sheikh, who subsequently executed and registered a will for .05 acres of land in favour of his two daughters, one wife and the daughter of Rahela Khatun by a registered will dated 29.3.77. The said Denatullah Sheikh further instructed his wife, daughter, grand son and grand-daughter to register the kabala in favour of the said vendees; that on the demise of Denatullah Sheikh his heirs being wife Amena Khatun, daughter Rahela Khatun, grand-son Abul Basaher and grand-daughter Aysa Khatun got his .05 acres of land and thereafter, the said heirs of Denatullah Sheikh in pursuance of bainapatra dated 28.4.72 executed and registered a bainapatra for .05 acres of land in favour of plaintiffs on 7.7.78 at a consideration of Tk.15,750/- out of which they received Tk.10,000.00 as earnest money. The vendors of the bainapatra dated 7.7.78 got all the price mentioned in the said bainapatra and that the plaintiff No.1 and his brother late Iftekharuddin Ahmed purchased .07 acres out of .12 acres of land as per terms of the registered bainapatra dated 28.2.72 from Denatullah Sheikh by a registered kabala No.19882 dated 21.10.74. The plaintiffs requested the defendant No.1 to execute and register .05 acres of land in favour of them on 9.8.95 which was denied by the defendant No.1. Thereafter, the plaintiff No.1 called a Salish at the Chamber of Advocate Mr. Hye in presence of Asadurraman, Mr. Niraj and Mr. Piku wherein a decision was made that the defendant No. 1 would register the kabala in favour of the plaintiffs within next six months. Later on, the plaintiffs again requested the defendant No.1 to execute the deed in favour of them but resulted nothing and the defendant No.1 lastly on 15.6.99 denied to execute the said deed. Hence the suit.
